subject.title: feat(android): add staged Wear status bridge

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor an official Wear OS companion beginning with this phone-first, status-only slice?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and well proven, but it creates a new official application and long-term release/maintenance surface that contributor code quality alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Sponsor status-only Wear
options.body: Accept the narrow phone-first status surface, require Android-owner review, and define the Wear publication path before announcing user availability.

options.title: Review the full Wear program
options.body: Pause this slice and evaluate it together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108997 as one coordinated product and security direction.

options.title: Decline official Wear support
options.body: Close the Wear PR series and avoid adding a new first-party application and release obligation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor status-only Wear
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow phone-first status surface, require Android-owner review, and define the Wear publication path before announcing user availability.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository documentation explicitly assigns Android app ownership to @obviyus.
